data.text: Gitignoring a tracked directory does not protect it on the next branch switch. After PR #4 merged, 'git checkout main && git pull' deleted docs/, tasks/, assets/, SPEC.md and scripts/kadence.mjs from disk: on the old branch they were still tracked, so the merge applied their deletion to the working tree. Ignoring only ever protects what git never tracked. Recovery was 'git checkout <commit before the removal> -- <paths>' plus 'git restore --staged', and it restores the committed version — uncommitted edits in docs/product/strategy.md were lost for good. Commit or stash anything valuable in such a directory before switching branches.
